name: Self Destruction
overview: Scripture reveals that self-destruction often begins with pride and a haughty heart, leading inevitably to downfall and ruin, as Proverbs teaches. This spiritual peril results in fear, snares, and desolation, illustrating the consequences of turning away from God’s truth. Yet, the gospel offers hope through Christ, who came to give abundant life and rescue us from perishing. Believers are called to repent from vain pursuits and turn to the living God, embracing humility and salvation rather than destruction.
